results.title: ICE officer pleads not guilty to lying about shooting and is released from custody
results.description: A U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement officer has been released from federal custody after pleading not guilty to lying to investigators about the circumstances that led to the shooting of a Venezuelan man during the Minnesota immigration crackdown last winter....

UN General Assembly endorses a new world map that shows more accurately Africa’s size
results.description: The United Nations General Assembly on Friday endorsed a new world map that represents Africa more accurately in its larger size, a culmination of a recent campaign led by African countries and advocacy groups.
